timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Imagine you're floating in the infinite cosmos, stars twinkling all around.
Now let's put that imagination to the test with some astronomy riddles.
First up, I'm all around yet hard to see. I hold the stars but not the key.
What am I? Pause. The answer? Dark matter.
Second, I'm a giant ball of gas, but Earth is the place I'll never pass. Who am I?
Think about it. Got it, it's Jupiter, our final riddle.
I'm the closest star to Earth yet I'm still so far.
Who am I? Pause for effect.
It's the Sun. So, how did you do? Did you get all three right or did the cosmos leave you starry
eyeed? Comment below to share your score and remember in the vast expansive space there are
always more riddles to unravel. Until next time, keep your eyes on the stars.
